en.institute: Coastal Research Institute of Mist Island
en.heroTitle: Monitoring changes in the marine environment
en.heroText: Hydrological, meteorological and technical measurements for the Mist Island region.
en.n1: Calibration has been completed. The stations have returned to the standard measurement cycle.
en.n2: A summary of salinity changes in the northern bay has been published.
en.n3: Archive maintenance is scheduled for January 18, 07:00–09:00.
en.aboutP1: The Institute monitors hydrological, meteorological and biological conditions around the island and the northern bay.
en.aboutP2: The network includes shore stations and automated measurement buoys. Archived data is available to authorised partners through TideArchive.
en.pub3: Wave analysis near the north-east lane
en.restricted: Access to historical records is restricted to authorised users.
